- **Failing test**: In [`VariableTest.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jxpath_6_group_c_arch/src/test/org/apache/commons/jxpath/ri/compiler/VariableTest.java#L276-L280), variable `$d` is declared with array `new String[] { "a", "b" }`.  
  ```
  junit.framework.AssertionFailedError: Evaluating <$d = 'a'> expected:<true> but was:<false>
  ```
- **Intended Behavior**: Under XPath specification rules for node-sets and multi-valued variables, evaluating equality between a collection/array variable and a literal value must yield `true` if any element of the collection/array matches the value.

The intended behavior has been specified as a living requirement in [requirement.feature](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jxpath_6_group_c_arch/requirement.feature).
